scope: Independent source review of late valid dummy-password hash correction only; no heavy command or test executed by this reviewer.
canonical_evidence: docs/engineering/PERMISSION_MATRIX.md — Admin Login Security, enumeration stance (around line200)
verdict: No source blocker identified in the bounded correction; real login response/permission/lockout policy unchanged.

checks.result: TIMING_DUMMY_HASH is private static final, used only for dummy work. dummyVerify returns void and discards match result. Unknown-account login branches still unconditionally reject; public sentinel matching the dummy does not authenticate any account.

Same existing Argon2PasswordEncoder instance and unchanged defaults create valid dummy and new account hashes. dummyVerify calls matches directly; historical malformed Base64 fast-warning path is removed. No encoder parameter/library/dependency change.

Class initialization generates one salted hash. Reused across service instances and attempts. One startup derivation plus ordinary existing Argon2 verification cost/temporary memory per dummy call; no persistent submitted-password/token fields or new shared mutable state.
Real hash(), verify(), legacy PHPass and WordPress bcrypt detection/verification and rehash routing unchanged. Rate limits, account lockout, permissions and endpoint validation untouched.

Admin/customer login requests require nonblank password. Password-reset service rejects null/blank login before dummy work. Removing exception swallowing does not introduce an identified null public input path.

New production code has no logging/transport/persistence of dummy value, submitted password or account hash. Unit logger capture restores logger state and avoids printing malformed-control warning to parent appenders.

Four plain unit cases inspect real generated parameter/salt/hash shape, verify its known synthetic sentinel and wrong value using actual encoder, contrast malformed historical control warning, exercise no-warning dummy inputs and static reuse. No wall-clock threshold or stubbed production crypto introduced.

test_execution: Lead is running targeted authentication tests and a final full backend verification after this late fix. This source review does not claim those runs passed.
measurement_limits: Same current Argon2 work is not proof of equal end-to-end wall time for every account, legacy hashing format, database lookup or lockout branch.
No reduction in authentication cost claimed. Valid dummy work intentionally performs existing policy cryptographic cost where malformed hash previously returned early.
Both benchmark arms retain the same correctness repair; this is excluded from the two measured optimization attributions.
